adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents()` to iterate over all entries to create events for multiple destination calendars. However, several post-booking flows (e.g. `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts` and `editLocation.handler.ts`, `requestReschedule.handler.ts`, plus payment webhook handlers) still construct `evt.destinationCalendar` as a single-item array derived only from `booking.destinationCalendar` or `user.destinationCalendar` (e.g. `destinationCalendar: booking?.destinationCalendar ? [booking.destinationCalendar] : ...`). In `handleNewBooking.ts`, collective events explicitly append other hosts' destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), but that multi-host list is not persisted (DB connect uses only `evt.destinationCalendar[0]`). So when confirmation/payment/reschedule/edit flows build a new `CalendarEvent` from the booking record, they lose the additional host calendars, and the new multi-create logic will only act on the single destination calendar provided.
